ns2:course.label: International Trade
ns2:course.description: The pure theory of international trade, general equilibrium income and welfare, tariffs, the theory of policy ranking, strategic trade policy, customs unions, international trade law and the WTO. Prerequisite: ECON 302 and ECON 303, or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 302 and ECON 303, or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
